citations.C1: Missing 'price'/'qty' keys—KeyError; validate schema or use dict.get().
citations.C2: None as price/qty—TypeError on conversion; check for None explicitly.
citations.C5: Decimal qty ("5.5")—ValueError on int(); use Decimal for all numerics.
citations.C6: float() for money—precision loss (0.1+0.2≠0.3); use Decimal('price').
citations.C7: Negative price—likely data error; validate price >= 0.
